welcome.title: Welcome to Business Details
welcome.desc: This page gives you complete control over a business — track performance, manage content, update settings, and more. Let's walk through the key areas together.

status.title: Status Control
status.desc: Instantly activate, suspend, or archive a business. Changes apply platform-wide the moment you save them.

actions.title: Actions Menu
actions.desc: Four shortcuts live here — Edit updates the full business profile, Change Owner transfers management to another user, Create Product links a new product to this business, and View Products opens its product list.

header.title: Business Identity
header.desc: The business name, logo, primary category, and profile completion score. A higher completion score improves visibility and trust on the platform.

stats.title: Real-Time Analytics
stats.desc: Live data on page views, unique visitors, clicks, bookmarks, shares, average engagement time, and conversion rate — your business performance at a glance.

tabs.title: Section Navigation
tabs.desc: Switch between Overview, Attributes, Contact, Location, Media, Social Networks, Delivery Policy, and Opening Hours using these tabs.

content.title: Section Details
content.desc: Each tab reveals the full content for that section. To edit any field, open the Actions menu and select 'Edit'.

welcome.title: Welcome to the Business Wizard
welcome.desc: This step-by-step wizard guides you through creating or editing a complete business profile. You can save a draft at any time and publish when ready.

header.title: Wizard Header
header.desc: Shows your current step and its title. The completion ring tracks real-time profile strength — publish once all required fields are filled.

stepper.title: Step Navigator
stepper.desc: 10 steps cover every aspect of a business: basic info, translations, contact, location, attributes, media, opening hours, delivery, online presence, and a final review. Click any step to jump directly to it.

completion.title: Completion Tracker
completion.desc: This ring updates live as you fill in fields. Green = 70%+, amber = 40–69%, red = below 40%. Reach 100% for the strongest profile visibility.

content.title: Step Content
content.desc: Fill in the details for the current step here. Required fields are marked — steps 1–5 must be completed before you can publish.

footer.title: Footer Navigation
footer.desc: Previous and Next move between steps. Save Draft stores your progress without publishing. Publish submits the business for review.

welcome.title: Welcome to Business Management
welcome.desc: Manage your entire business portfolio from one place — browse, filter, create, and track performance. Let's walk through the key features.

page_header.title: Page Overview
page_header.desc: The live business count sits next to the title. Hit 'Add Business' to register a new business through the step-by-step creation wizard.

stats.title: Portfolio Snapshot
stats.desc: Six live metrics: total registered businesses, active ones, total products, average impact score, pending approvals, and average profile completion rate.

search.title: Smart Search
search.desc: Find any business instantly by name, email, or phone number. Results refresh as you type — no submit needed.

toolbar.title: Toolbar
toolbar.desc: Four tools in one row — open the Filter panel, show or hide table columns, export the current view to CSV, and switch between list and grid display.

filter_panel.title: Filter Panel
filter_panel.desc: Narrow results by status (Active, Pending, Archived) or by whether a business has products. Active filters appear as removable chips above the list.

business_list.title: Business List
business_list.desc: Click any row to open the full business profile. Use the checkboxes to select multiple businesses and apply bulk actions — status change or deletion — in one go.

welcome.title: Welcome to Products Management
welcome.desc: Manage your entire product catalog from one place — browse, filter, create, and track sales performance. Let's walk through the key features.

page_header.title: Page Overview
page_header.desc: The live product count sits next to the title. Hit 'Add Product' to register a new product through the step-by-step creation wizard.

stats.title: Sales Snapshot
stats.desc: Four live metrics: all-time revenue, total units sold, average product price, and revenue generated this month.

search.title: Smart Search
search.desc: Find any product instantly by name or business. Results refresh as you type — no submit needed.

toolbar.title: Toolbar
toolbar.desc: Five tools in one row — open the Filter panel, show or hide table columns, export the current view to CSV, take this tour again, and switch between list and grid display.

filter_panel.title: Filter Panel
filter_panel.desc: Narrow results by status or by the business a product belongs to. Active filters appear as removable chips above the list.

product_list.title: Product List
product_list.desc: Click any row to open the full product profile. Use the checkboxes to select multiple products and apply bulk actions in one go.

welcome.title: Welcome to Event Session Management
welcome.desc: This dashboard gives you full control over event sessions — configure guest-facing landing pages, monitor seat capacity in real time, track attendance analytics, send targeted notifications, and manage all registrations from one place. Let's explore each section together.

page_header.title: Page Overview
page_header.desc: The title and description identify this management area at a glance. The five tabs below divide the full event lifecycle into focused sections so you always know exactly where you are.

tabs_nav.title: Section Navigator
tabs_nav.desc: Five tabs cover every stage of an event: Landing Page to configure the guest booking experience, Capacity Report for live seat monitoring, Analytics for attendance insights, Notifications to message registrants, and Registrations to manage all bookings.

landing.title: Landing Page
landing.desc: Design the guest-facing booking page from here — set the hero background image, brand name, main heading, available sessions, and whether guests can book one or multiple sessions at once. Every change is instantly previewable.

capacity.title: Capacity Report
capacity.desc: Monitor live seat availability across every session and time slot. Each row shows total capacity, booked seats, active holds, attendees who arrived, and remaining spots — updated in real time so you always have an accurate picture.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.desc: Visualise registration trends and occupancy rates broken down by session. Track total registrations, actual attendance, no-show rate, and overall occupancy to inform planning decisions for future events.

notify.title: Notifications
notify.desc: Send targeted messages to registrants via email or SMS. Pick your audience, choose a channel, write your subject and body, and review the complete send history — all from one consolidated panel.

regs.title: Registrations
regs.desc: Browse and manage every booking in a single table. Each row shows the booking reference, registrant name, contact details, and attendance status. You can also reset all demo data from this tab when needed.
